City of Chicago

                            Office of the City Clerk
                           Document Tracking Sheet



Meeting Date:                 5/24/2023
Sponsor(s):                   Rodriguez (22)
Type:                         Ordinance
Title:                        Zoning Reclassification Map No. 6-K at 43339 -- 433387 W.
                              Ogden Ave.
Commlttee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                                 ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance Is amended by changing all of the C2-
2, Motor Vehicle-Related Commercial District, M1-2, Limited
Manufacturing/Business Park District, and M2-2, Light Industry District symbols
and Indications as shown on Map No. 6-K In the area bound by:

      West Ogden Avenue, South Kolin Avenue, the former Chicago, Burlington, and
      Quincy railroad right of way, and South Kostner Avenue

to those of a C1-1, Neighborhood Commercial District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after Its passage and publication.




                                            Michael Rodriguez
                                            Alderman, 22"^ Ward




Common Address:
43339-87 West Ogden Avenue
